source_locator: Printed pp. 28-29, Employment in game production
definition: Historical employment estimate for the Polish game-production sector, restated by the 2020 PARP/GIC report. The report calls it a historical estimate and says it was slightly underestimated; its original vintage and detailed population method were not recovered in this bounded pass.

source_locator: Printed p. 8 overview infographic; printed pp. 28-29, Employment in game production
definition: Game Industry Conference's tighter estimate of 9,710 full-time employees in Poland's game-production sector. The scope includes game-production studios, external-development companies and global publishers; it excludes Polish local-market distribution and non-production service providers, including separately discussed QA/localisation providers.
